name: unicode_fancy_script
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle a message written in Unicode mathematical/fancy script characters and still understand the intent

expected_behaviors.description: AI should recognize the word 'melamine' despite the fancy Unicode script

notes: Message uses Unicode mathematical script characters (𝓗𝓮𝓵𝓵𝓸 = Hello, 𝓘 𝓷𝓮𝓮𝓭 𝓶𝓮𝓵𝓪𝓶𝓲𝓷𝓮 = I need melamine). The AI should either decode the fancy text and respond about melamine, or ask for clarification if it cannot parse the characters. It should not crash.
